_doc: Arm C of the real-rules A/B (2026-11-02): bighero's exact from-scratch recipe (lr 3e-4, fixed entropy 0.01, no_peace, loss for both seats at the cap) with ONE change: strong developers in the opponent pool - hero1 (hero-1v1 final u14871) and hero_u11650 (hero-1v1-cont1h), old-rules 4x128 nets widened to observation v2 with zero rows (exact), each at 15% of lanes (self-play 50%, historical 10%, pool remainder). Arm A (capfix-a, score at the cap) reproduced bighero's no-growth equilibrium (builds/game 3.7, city levels frozen from turn 14, behind bighero at equal updates), so the cap rule is not the lever; this arm tests whether an opponent that punishes non-growth is. Gate at ~u4000: builds/game > 12 and city levels rising at turn 16 (trace arena vs champion), >=55% vs bighero_u3880.
